tags.description: 3-6 lowercase topic tags, kebab-case, English or Polish without diacritics

context.description: when and where the source was made and what was going on; only as much as the theses need; approximate dates marked as such

theses.description: each item: **bold thesis:** explanation in own words

reasoning.description: how the person gets to the conclusion: analogy, history, inversion, probabilities, arithmetic; what they admit as a mistake or as not knowing

quotes.description: 0-2 verbatim lines from the source, original language, the person's own words

change.description: what is new, dropped or repeated against earlier sources of the same person; only sources actually seen

doubts.description: anything doubtful: approximate date, ASR garbling, sponsored content, missing speakers; empty string if none
